about: H.K. Skip Pita is a personal injury attorney at Pita, Weber & Del Prado, in Miami, Florida. Mr. Pita handles all types of personal injury matters, including those involving medical malpractice, class action and mass torts. He serves clients throughout the Miami metropolitan area, providing personalized service and zealous advocacy.

During his more than 20 years in practice, Mr. Pita has successfully collected substantial amounts in verdicts and settlements for injured Florida residents and their family members. He has been included in the Million Dollar Advocates Forum, an organization whose membership is open only to attorneys who have secured verdicts or settlements in excess of $1 million. On behalf of his clients, he has prevailed against powerful opponents such as large insurance carriers and prestigious defense law firms throughout Florida.

Florida Trend magazine included Mr. Pita on its “Legal Elite” list. The National Trial Lawyers named him one of the “Top 100 Lawyers in Florida” and one of the “Top 25 Lawyers for medical malpractice.” U.S. News & World Report and “The Best Lawyers in America” have also recognized him for his accomplishments.

Mr. Pita is a fellow and former board member of the Florida Justice Association. He lectures on closing arguments at conferences and seminars and is a member of the Miami Dade County Trial Lawyers Association, the Florida Justice Association, the American Association for Justice and The National Trial Lawyers.

After earning his bachelor’s degree, Mr. Pita attended and graduated from Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law in Dallas, Texas. He holds a license to practice law before all Florida state courts.
